name: vm-pro-lab
description: VM Pro Lab - Desarrollo Web Profesional

scripts.minify:html: html-minifier-terser index.html -o dist/index.html --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --minify-css --minify-js && sed -i.bak 's|href="css/styles\.css"|href="css/styles.min.css"|g; s|src="js/main\.js"|src="js/main.min.js"|g' dist/index.html && rm dist/index.html.bak
scripts.minify: npm run minify:css && npm run minify:js
scripts.copy:assets: npm run copy:fonts && npm run copy:images && npm run copy:icons
scripts.copy:extras: cp robots.txt favicon.ico favicon-16x16.png favicon-32x32.png apple-touch-icon.png android-chrome-192x192.png android-chrome-512x512.png site.webmanifest _headers dist/
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run sync:critical && npm run minify && npm run minify:html && npm run version:assets && npm run copy:assets && npm run copy:extras

author: VM Pro Lab
